## Introduction

## Application

### Data

Download

```{r download, include = FALSE}
download.file("http://www.wiod.org/protected3/data16/wiot_ROW/wiot_r_Nov16.zip", destfile = "~/data/wiod/wiot_data.zip")
```
```{r download, eval = FALSE}
download.file("http://www.wiod.org/protected3/data16/wiot_ROW/wiot_r_Nov16.zip", destfile = "wiot_data.zip")
```

Unzip the file

```{r unzip, include = FALSE}
unzip("~/data/wiod/wiot_data.zip", exdir = "~/data/wiod")
```
```{r unzip, eval = FALSE}
unzip("wiot_data.zip")
```

Read in the file

```{r read}
data <- c()
for (i in 2000:2014) {
  file_name <- paste("~/data/wiod/WIOT", i, "_October16_ROW.RData", sep = "")
  load(file_name)
  data <- rbind(data, wiot)
}
rm(wiot)
```

```{r, message = FALSE}
country <- "AUT"

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

ind_index <- data %>%
  select(IndustryCode, RNr) %>%
  distinct()

data <- data %>%
  filter(Country == country) %>%
  gather(key = "user", value = "value", -(IndustryCode:Year)) %>%
  select(Year,IndustryCode, Country, user, value) %>%
  rename(year = Year,
         add_ind = IndustryCode,
         add_ctr = Country) %>%
  mutate(user_ind = as.numeric(substring(user, 4, 5)),
         user_ctr = substring(user, 1, 3)) %>%
  filter(user_ind %in% c(1:61)) %>%
  left_join(ind_index, by = c("user_ind" = "RNr")) %>%
  mutate(user_ind = ifelse(!is.na(IndustryCode), substring(IndustryCode, 1, 1), user_ind),
         add_ind = substring(add_ind, 1, 1)) %>%
  group_by(year, add_ind, add_ctr, user_ind, user_ctr) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value)) %>%
  ungroup() 
```

```{r}
temp_index <- ind_index %>%
  mutate(ind = substring(IndustryCode, 1, 1))
temp_index <- unique(temp_index$ind)

temp <- data %>%
  mutate(var = case_when(user_ctr == country & user_ind %in% temp_index ~ "interm_domestic",
                         user_ctr != country & user_ind %in% temp_index ~ "interm_foreign",
                         user_ctr == country & !user_ind %in% temp_index ~ "final_domestic",
                         user_ctr != country & !user_ind %in% temp_index ~ "final_foreign",
                         TRUE ~ "0_Fail :)")) %>%
  group_by(year, var) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value))
```


```{r, message = FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.5}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(temp, aes(x = year, y = value, fill = var)) +
  geom_col()
```
